tagline: We make a number for every game. We bet the ones where the market's wrong.

games.title: Baltimore @ Buffalo
games.take: The week's heavyweight noon game: Buffalo is 5-1 coming off its bye, a spot it has won 11 straight times, while Lamar Jackson returns for Baltimore after missing three games with an ankle sprain — the Ravens went 1-2 without him and scored 13 or fewer in their last two. Dalton Kincaid is questionable with a chest injury but arrived on his usual game-day schedule and is expected to play. This one is on the board: Buffalo -159 at Courtside beats a 62.2% devigged Pinnacle fair for +1.4% EV while Pinnacle itself hangs -173. Weather is no factor in Orchard Park, around 68 degrees with a light wind.
games.verdict: LEAN: Buffalo -159 — a real edge, because Courtside is 14 cents short of Pinnacle on the home favorite.

games.title: Tennessee @ Cincinnati
games.take: The biggest mismatch on the slate: Cincinnati is 4-2 behind a hot Joe Burrow while Tennessee is 1-6, just traded Jeffery Simmons to Chicago, and travels without leading receiver Carnell Tate (shoulder) and running back Tyjae Spears (knee). Calvin Ridley is questionable with a hip injury but expected to play. This one is on the board: Cincinnati -670 at BetRivers beats an 88.5% devigged Pinnacle fair for +1.7% EV while the rest of the market hangs -800 to -850 — a steep lay, priced honestly, not a bargain to celebrate. Cincinnati is cloudy and calm, around 70 degrees, with no weather alerts.
games.verdict: LEAN: Cincinnati -670 — a real edge, because BetRivers is far short of the rest of the market on a heavy favorite.

games.title: Cleveland @ Pittsburgh
games.take: First place in the AFC North is on the line with both teams at 5-2. Cleveland is as healthy as it has been all season — right tackle Tytus Howard cleared concussion protocol Saturday — while Pittsburgh is down cornerbacks Brandin Echols and Doneiko Slaughter with hamstring injuries. The total (38.5) is the lowest on the slate, which fits a division game in November. This one is on the board: Pittsburgh -181 at Courtside beats a 65.3% devigged Pinnacle fair for +1.4% EV while Pinnacle hangs -198. Pittsburgh is overcast and calm, around 66 degrees.
games.verdict: LEAN: Pittsburgh -181 — a real edge, because Courtside is 17 cents short of Pinnacle at home.

games.title: Minnesota @ Detroit
games.take: The unbeaten team is the underdog: Minnesota arrives 6-0 with Kyler Murray at quarterback, while Detroit is 4-2 behind Jared Goff's 14 touchdowns against zero interceptions. Jahmyr Gibbs and Amon-Ra St. Brown finished the week as full participants, but Detroit is without All-Pro safety Kerby Joseph (knee) and its pass defense ranks last in yards allowed — the clear path for the Vikings. This one is on the board: Detroit -166 at Courtside beats a 63.4% devigged Pinnacle fair for +1.6% EV while Pinnacle hangs -182. Ford Field is indoors, so weather is irrelevant.
games.verdict: LEAN: Detroit -166 — a real edge, because Courtside is 16 cents short of Pinnacle on the home favorite.

games.title: Indianapolis @ Jacksonville
games.take: Jacksonville is a 10-point home favorite, and the game side itself is priced at fair — no edge on either moneyline at US prices. The edge in this game is a prop: Trevor Lawrence Over 1.5 passing touchdowns is -186 at BetRivers against a 66.5% devigged FanDuel fair (FanDuel charges -225, DraftKings -195) for +2.3% EV. Jacksonville's forecast is the one weather watch on the slate, with rain showers and wind in the forecast, but that is a note, not a severe-weather flag.
games.verdict: LEAN: Trevor Lawrence Over 1.5 passing TDs — a real edge, because BetRivers is 39 cents short of FanDuel on the prop.

games.title: LA Chargers @ LA Rams
games.matchup: Los Angeles Chargers @ Los Angeles Rams
games.our_fair: LA Rams 73.7% / LA Chargers 26.3% (devigged Pinnacle fair)
games.take: The battle for Los Angeles is lopsided on paper: the Chargers are 0-6 coming off their bye and just placed Derwin James on injured reserve after a hamstring setback, while the Rams are 3-4 and coming off a 35-21 win over Las Vegas. The Rams are banged up too — Davante Adams and Terrance Ferguson are on IR — but Puka Nacua carries the passing game. This one is on the board: LA Rams -263 at Courtside beats a 73.7% devigged Pinnacle fair for +1.8% EV while Pinnacle hangs -298. SoFi is indoors.
games.verdict: LEAN: LA Rams -263 — a real edge, because Courtside is 35 cents short of Pinnacle on the home favorite.

games.title: Kansas City @ Denver
games.venue: Empower Field at Mile High, Denver, CO
games.take: The afternoon's true coin flip: Kansas City is a 1.5-point road favorite in Denver, and the Pinnacle fair is essentially 50-50. No true edge here at US prices — Kansas City -115 and Denver -103 both sit on the wrong side of fair. The lean is Denver because its price is the least-bad of the two, and Denver at altitude in a near pick'em is a live home dog. Denver is mostly cloudy and calm, around 61 degrees, with no weather alerts.
games.verdict: LEAN: Denver — no true edge, but the lean is Denver because it is the closest price to fair in a coin-flip game.

games.title: Philadelphia @ Washington
games.take: Sunday night football closes the slate with Washington a 6.5-point home favorite. The Pinnacle fair makes Washington a 71.5% favorite, and no US price beats it — Washington -265 is the least-bad number, Philadelphia's +210 to +230 is further from fair. No true edge here, but the lean is Washington because the home favorite's price is closest to the fair number. Landover is partly cloudy and calm, around 51 degrees at kickoff, with no weather alerts.
games.verdict: LEAN: Washington — no true edge, but the lean is Washington because it is the closest price to fair under the lights.
